Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 




SPECIFICATION FOR 

ROUND WASHERS WITH SQUARE HOLE 

FOR WOOD FASTENINGS 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for washers with square hole for use in wood fastenings with 
bolts in the diameter range 6 to 24 mm. 

2. Grade — Shall conform to ordinary grade of 13:5369-1975 'General requirements for plain 
washers and fock washers {firsl revision ) \ 

3. Dimensions — As given in Table 1. 



TABLE 1 DIMENSIONS OF WASHERS WITH SQUARE HOLE

3.1 Dimensional tolerances as well as tolerance for form and position shall conform to those of 

ordinary washers of IS : 5369-1975. 

4. Material — Washers with square hole for wood fastenings shall be made from any low carbon 
steel or any other material specified by the purchaser. 

5. Designation — A round washer with square hole shall be designated by the name, nominal size 
and the number of this standard.

IS : 8033 * 1976 

Example: 

A round washer with square hole of nominal size 14 mm shall be designated as: 
Washer With Square Hole 14 »S : 8033 

6. General Requirements —In regard to the requirements not covered in this standard, they shall 
conform to the requirements of IS : 5369-1975. 

7, 151 Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Round washers with square hole for wood fastenings are intended for use with coach bolts 
conforming to IS : 2609-1972 ' Coach bolts ( M6 to M24 ) {first revision ) '. !n the preparation of this 
standard considerable assistance has been derived from DIN 440 ' Schieben vorwiegend fur 
Hoizkonstruktionen ( Round washers for wood constructions ), 1974 ' issued by DIN Deutsches Institut 
fur Normung, 



Printed al Neelkamel Printers. Delhi. India
